name: snb_data-mcp
display_name: Swiss National Bank data portal MCP
description: Swiss National Bank data portal (market data): get_series. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: series_id is '<cube>/<D0 item>/<D1 item>' for two-dimensional cubes, e.g. 'devkum/M0/EUR1' (monthly average CHF per 1 EUR), 'devkum/M1/USD1' (end of month, USD). start/end are sent as YYYY-MM. Rows without a value are left out.
